config.description: Vitest configuration file the run loads, relative to the workspace root, whose folder the run starts from

projects.description: Vitest projects the task runs, passed as --project, every project the configuration resolves where empty

attachmentsDir.description: Folder the task's projects write attachments to, relative to the workspace root, the run's attachmentsDir where the task runs alone

coverage.description: Coverage options of the run over the coverage words after --, reportsDirectory relative to the workspace root, which every run enabling coverage writes to and the coverage configuration of the target enables

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, parsed as vitest run arguments

title: Test
description: Runs vitest run in a child process of its own once over the projects of every batched task sharing a configuration and its options, one Vite server and one worker pool the configuration's maxWorkers sizes, side by side with the runs of other option groups, a task running coverage alone, and decides each task from the test modules of its own projects
